title: Multi-Indicator Multi-TF Dashboard Revise2 (20-pair UI+auto-trade grouping)
entry_long: per-symbol group auto-mode: after manual first buy in a symbol's group, if price runs up, system opens additional buy orders every grid-distance pips (config'd per symbol/group)
entry_short: mirror: after manual first sell, price runs down, system adds sell orders every grid-distance pips
exit: each order has SL and TP set (values not stated); auto-mode stopped via per-symbol Stop-Auto button which resets the group flag to 0
escalation_cap: unspecified (grid continues while trend persists; no explicit lot escalation, just repeated fixed-size adds)
buildon_idea: this is a UI/scaling revision (10->20 pairs) of the EX134 dashboard EA; buildable extension: add per-symbol Edit-Fields for lot/SL/TP/grid-distance instead of hardcoded constants, and cap total concurrent groups active to control aggregate exposure
novelty_note: admin/tooling-heavy video (chart-switch buttons, auto/stop-auto buttons, magic-number grouping per symbol via MQL4 code); mechanism itself (grid-follow with SL/TP) is simple and common

title: Multi-Indicator Multi-Timeframe Dashboard (EMA+RSI signal panel, manual multi-symbol entry)
symbol: 10 pairs incl. EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY...NZDUSD (unspecified full list)
timeframe: M5, M15, M30, H1, H4 (dashboard shows all 5 per symbol)
entry_long: dashboard shows up-arrow (blue) per symbol/TF when EMA fast>slow (uptrend) or RSI>60; trader manually clicks Buy button for that symbol row based on the signal panel
entry_short: mirror: down-arrow (pink) when EMA fast<slow or RSI<40; trader manually clicks Sell button
exit: fixed SL 100 pips, TP 100 pips per order; plus panel buttons Close-All-Symbol / Close-Profit-Trade / Close-Loss-Trade for manual bulk close; also global equity-based close at +$100/-$100 profit
buildon_idea: pure manual-assist signal dashboard (not autonomous entry logic) across 10 pairs x 5 TFs; buildable extension: convert the arrow-agreement (EMA-trend + RSI-level align across multiple TFs) into an automated entry filter instead of manual button clicks, and test as a multi-symbol trend-confirmation EA
novelty_note: multi-symbol multi-timeframe EMA+RSI confluence panel is a common dashboard concept; the loop-based object-creation coding technique (not the trading idea) is the actual teaching focus

title: Semi-Auto EA (MT5): manual first entry + automatic FL-Train (trend-follow+trailing) / Reverse-Train (grid recovery w/ ATR-scaled trailing)
indicators: ATR (average true range, for adaptive trailing stop)
entry_long: first buy opened manually via on-chart button or mobile (no signal logic, no SL/TP); after that, if price rises system adds buy every 100 pips (FL-Train/trend mode) and starts ATR-scaled trailing stop once 2+ orders open
entry_short: mirror: manual first sell, then if price falls adds sell every 100 pips + ATR-scaled trailing stop
exit: FL-Train mode: ATR-adaptive trailing stop (base 100 pips x ATR multiplier, step 1 pip). Reverse-Train (losing) mode: grid-adds every 100 pips capped in lot growth by a counter (+0.01 lot per 5 grid orders), closes all when unrealized profit exceeds a money target that scales with order count (close_money = 5 + count/5*5)
lot_law: linear-add (stepped: +0.01 lot every 5 orders in loss-recovery mode)
escalation_cap: none stated for max order count in this transcript (lot step capped per-5-orders but no explicit ceiling on total grid orders)
buildon_idea: manual-trigger + automated bidirectional management (profit-trail vs loss-grid) is a reusable pattern; buildable extension: add a hard max-order cap and a hard SL on the grid-recovery side (currently no_sl + no explicit order cap = structural risk), then flat-lot test the entry-quality assumption since entries here are 100% discretionary
novelty_note: semi-auto (human picks entry, EA manages exit/averaging) design is distinctive vs standard auto-EA lineage; can layer any external/AI indicator for the entry signal since entry is manual

title: Semi-Auto EA (MT4/BTC): manual first entry + FL-Train grid-profit / Reverse-Train engulfing-confirmed martingale recovery
symbol: BTC (bitcoin, per grid distance 10000 'pips' tuned for BTC); noted to need re-tuning per symbol e.g. EURUSD
indicators: bullish/bearish engulfing (candlestick pattern) as grid-recovery confirmation filter
entry_long: first buy opened manually via chart button (no logic, no SL/TP)
entry_short: first sell opened manually via chart button
exit: FL-Train (winning) mode: grid-add every 10,000 pips then trailing stop (10,000/1,000). Reverse-Train (losing) mode: wait for bullish/bearish engulfing confirmation before each grid recovery add, lot increases every add by L_Plus=0.01 (linear-add, e.g. 0.01->0.02), closes group when unrealized profit > 10,000 pips
escalation_cap: none stated in this transcript (no max-order or lot ceiling constant shown)
buildon_idea: engulfing-confirmed grid recovery (only adds after a reversal candle confirms, not blindly every N pips) is a meaningful risk-reduction over plain martingale; buildable extension: add explicit max-order/lot cap (missing here) and test the engulfing-filter's edge in flat-lot mode before trusting the recovery logic at scale
novelty_note: candlestick-confirmed martingale add (vs blind distance-only add) is a moderate refinement worth cataloging; same semi-auto architecture as EX135 MT5 variant, ported to MT4/BTC

title: Multi-Group Scalping EA v1: 3-candle reversal pattern + Stochastic filter, dual independent buy/sell groups
indicators: 3-candle reversal pattern (bear,bull,bull = bullish reversal; bull,bear,bear = bearish reversal, min body 2 pips)
entry_long: group1: no open buy in group1 + 3-candle bullish reversal pattern (ID3 bear, ID2 bull, ID1 bull) + Stochastic above level 30 -> open buy 0.01 lot
entry_short: group2: no open sell in group2 + 3-candle bearish reversal pattern (ID3 bull, ID2 bear, ID1 bear) + Stochastic below level 70 -> open sell 0.01 lot
exit: per group: if price runs favorably, grid-add every 20 pips (fixed 0.01 lot) then trailing stop (20/1) once 2+ orders in group; if price runs against, grid recovery add every 20 pips at same fixed 0.01 lot, close all in group when profit clears; no SL/TP on individual orders
lot_law: grid-add (fixed 0.01 lot per add, no lot escalation in this version)
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed lot, no escalation); no explicit max-order cap stated
buildon_idea: already fixed-lot (not martingale) so main gap is no SL and no stated max-order cap on the grid side; backtest shown (2024, ~9mo, DD 5.13%, +22.6%) is a real PF>1 data point per user build-on doctrine -> extend to more symbols/TFs and add a max-order cap before trusting further
novelty_note: dual-group (buy vs sell fully independent, no netting) architecture with reversal-candle + stochastic dual-confirmation entry is a reasonable, non-trivial setup; author reports backtest showing low DD

title: Multi-Group Scalping EA v2 (capped): 3-candle reversal + Stochastic, stepped martingale w/ explicit lot-jump and max-order caps
symbol: XAUUSD (gold, per author's own tuning e.g. grid_distance/tailing values)
entry_long: group1, no open buy: 3-candle bullish reversal (ID3 bear/ID2 bull/ID1 bull) + Stochastic oversold (<20) -> buy 0.01 lot, with Volume_Upper_Limit=0.1 lot hard cap to prevent lot-jump
entry_short: group2, no open sell: 3-candle bearish reversal + Stochastic overbought (>80) -> sell 0.01 lot, same 0.1 lot cap
exit: winning mode: grid-add every 100 pips then ATR-scaled trailing stop once 2+ orders; losing mode: grid-recovery add every 100 pips, lot increases by +0.01 every 5 recovery orders (stepped, not every order), hard Max_Order=50 cap per group, closes when profit exceeds a scaling Cross_Money formula (grows with order count to avoid closing group at a net loss); no SL/TP on individual orders
escalation_cap: Volume_Upper_Limit=0.1 lot (per-order cap) + Max_Order=50 (per-group order-count cap) -- both explicit
buildon_idea: already capped (0.1 lot ceiling + 50-order max) so this is directly buildable per user doctrine: flat-lot test to isolate entry edge from the martingale step, then extend across more symbol/TF pairs (author notes it should also be tuned per-symbol for grid distance/ATR params)
novelty_note: explicit anti-lot-jump cap + max-order cap + count-scaled close-money formula (avoids closing a big recovery group at a small loss) are all deliberate risk-engineering choices worth reusing regardless of this EA's own verdict

title: Multi-Group Scouting EA: 'special doji' (long-wick) candle + RSI(7) extremes, dual independent buy/sell groups, grid-profit/recovery
timeframe: M5 (uses RSI period 7 tuned for small TF)
indicators: special doji candlestick (one wick > 2x opposite wick AND wick > body)
entry_long: group1, no open buy: candle ID1 lower wick > 2x upper wick AND lower wick > body (special doji) + RSI(7) < 30 (oversold) -> buy 0.01 lot, once-per-bar filter
entry_short: group2, no open sell: candle ID1 upper wick > 2x lower wick AND upper wick > body (special doji) + RSI(7) > 70 (overbought) -> sell 0.01 lot, once-per-bar filter
exit: winning mode: grid-add every 15 pips then trailing stop (20/1) once 2+ orders in group; losing mode: grid-recovery add every 15 pips, lot increases by +0.01 every single recovery order (continuous, not stepped), closes group when profit exceeds 15 pips; no SL/TP on individual orders
lot_law: martingale (every recovery order adds +0.01 lot, continuous not stepped)
escalation_cap: none stated in this transcript (no Volume_Upper_Limit or Max_Order constant mentioned, unlike the EX136 v2 sibling)
buildon_idea: same author's EX136-v2 pattern (a few videos later) added explicit lot-jump + max-order caps for a near-identical architecture -- direct fix: port those two caps (Volume_Upper_Limit, Max_Order) onto this EA; backtest shown (9mo 2024, DD 31.3%, +333%) is high-DD so caps + flat-lot test are priority before any further use
novelty_note: builds explicitly on author's own EX86 (cited in video), adding independent buy/sell groups + a FL-Train grid-profit leg that EX86 lacked; 'special doji' wick-ratio definition is a specific, codifiable candlestick filter
